style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the strip is a bar of milk chocolate pieces: chocolate-brown digit keys, a berry-pink Enter (a treat of the same world), butter-caramel rub out, a cream-caramel panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Description 'Lift one part off the strip, split it into ten again, and again'; Look 'A strip of ten on the left, a magnifier on the right holding the piece being split'; Stage 'cut into ten pieces of 42 each, touching along their edges': a strip with no material named that the child lifts a piece from and splits, so one milk chocolate piece, drawn for every piece of the strip and every sliver in the glass (the table's row for a strip the child cuts).
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate with a softly raised rim and a gentle gloss on its smooth, deep brown surface.

images.why: Owner 2026-10-16: phase 2's hundred grid is a chocolate slab like phase 1's chocolate strip, from the first frame (it was plain pink before Lift). One picture over the whole 10 x 10 grid; the cells, their lines and the shading are drawn in code on top.
images.prompt: One square slab of milk chocolate seen from directly above, smooth flat top with a soft glossy sheen and a gently bevelled edge, warm milk-chocolate brown, no markings or squares on it.
